title: Prana Farms Annual Pumpkin Festival
address: 6026 Sweden Blvd, Punta Gorda, FL 33982
description: Punta Gorda's premier family autumn tradition featuring thousands of farm-fresh pumpkins, walk-through butterfly encounters, friendly farm animal petting zoo, inflatables, barrel train rides, and rustic fall photo setups.
familyTip: Wear closed-toe shoes for the farm paths. Mornings around 10:00 AM have the lightest crowds and best photo lighting!
mapsQuery: Prana Farms, 6026 Sweden Blvd, Punta Gorda, FL 33982

title: City of Punta Gorda Fall Festival
address: 100 Nesbit St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950
description: A wholesome waterfront autumn festival on the harbor with trick-or-treating stations, inflatables, lawn games, live kids DJ entertainment, food trucks, and a costume contest with prizes by age group.
familyTip: Parking is available along Nesbit St and near the marina. Bring candy buckets and sunscreen since it's an afternoon outdoor event on the lawn.
mapsQuery: Laishley Park, 100 Nesbit St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950

title: Halloween Notte: Family Fun & Haunts
address: 2333 El Jobean Rd, Port Charlotte, FL 33948
description: Charlotte County's flagship Halloween attraction with a dual experience: a friendly daytime-style carnival midway with pumpkin patches, bounce houses, petting zoo, safe trick-or-treat booths, alongside separately enclosed spooky walk-through haunted zones for braver kids and teens.
familyTip: Families with toddlers and younger kids should stick to the illuminated family midway area. Arrive right at 6:00 PM when gates open.
mapsQuery: Charlotte County Fairgrounds, 2333 El Jobean Rd, Port Charlotte, FL 33948

title: Venice Nights Market & Music (Halloween Edition)
address: 1800 Harbor Dr S, Venice, FL 34285
description: Coastal evening celebration right on the Gulf featuring a costumed pet parade, youth costume promenade, live bands, artisan craft vendors, and 20+ local food trucks against a scenic Gulf sunset.
familyTip: Great excuse to visit Venice family! Bring beach chairs and blankets to sit on the grass lawn while listening to the band.
mapsQuery: Maxine Barritt Park, 1800 Harbor Dr S, Venice, FL 34285

title: North Port Trick-or-Treat & Pumpkin Trail
venue: George Mullen Activity Center / City Center Green
address: 4956 City Center Blvd, North Port, FL 34286
description: North Port's most beloved family Halloween night! Features the famous illuminated Pumpkin Trail with dozens of local business booths handing out candy, a DJ-led Monster Mash dance pit, costume contests, and food vendors.
familyTip: Very popular event! Parking fills up quickly at City Center; carpool with North Port family or arrive 20 minutes before 5:00 PM.
mapsQuery: George Mullen Activity Center, 4956 City Center Blvd, North Port, FL

title: Babcock Ranch Halloween Nights
address: 42850 Crescent Loop, Babcock Ranch, FL 33982
description: An eco-friendly solar town Halloween celebration featuring an extravagant decorated golf cart parade, lakeside trick-or-treating stations, spooky maze fun, food trucks, and music around Founder's Square boardwalk.
familyTip: The golf cart parade is a massive crowd pleaser for toddlers and kids. Grab a spot along Crescent Loop around 5:45 PM.
mapsQuery: Founder's Square, 42850 Crescent Loop, Babcock Ranch, FL

title: Wellen Park Spooktacular
address: 19745 Wellen Pkwy, Venice, FL 34293
description: Downtown Wellen turns into an open-air Halloween plaza! Stroll the beautiful pedestrian promenade around the lake for trick-or-treating at local merchants, interactive lawn games, live DJ music, and family costume contests.
familyTip: Perfect meeting point halfway between Punta Gorda and Venice! Paved, wide walkways make it 100% stroller and wagon friendly.
mapsQuery: Downtown Wellen, 19745 Wellen Pkwy, Venice, FL 34293

title: Historic Downtown Venice Halloween Strut
address: West Venice Ave & Miami Ave, Venice, FL 34285
description: A long-held Venice holiday tradition where hundreds of costumed children and parents stroll under the palm trees along Tampa, Venice, and Miami Avenues. Friendly shopkeepers and downtown merchants hand out treats outside their stores.
familyTip: Ends at 6:00 PM, leaving plenty of time to grab an early family dinner downtown before traditional neighborhood trick-or-treating!
mapsQuery: West Venice Ave, Venice, FL 34285

title: HOWLo'WEEN BOOlevard Trick-or-Treat
address: 164 Eric St, North Port, FL 34287
description: A vibrant North Port neighborhood trick-or-treating street walk with decorated tents, safe community treat zones, music, and kid photo stations.
familyTip: Convenient for families visiting relatives in North Port on Halloween evening.
mapsQuery: 164 Eric St, North Port, FL 34287

title: Grand Lighting of Fishermen's Village
address: 1200 W Retta St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950
description: The official grand kickoff of Southwest Florida's Christmas season! Count down with Santa and Mrs. Claus as over one million dazzling lights simultaneously illuminate throughout the village, accompanied by bagpipers, carolers, and holiday cheer.
familyTip: Punta Gorda's signature event of the year! Arrive by 4:30 PM to secure parking in the main lot or take the overflow shuttle.
mapsQuery: Fishermen's Village, 1200 W Retta St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950

title: Festival of Lights at Fishermen's Village
address: 1200 W Retta St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950
timeDisplay: All Day & Evening (Lights turn on at 5:30 PM)
description: Ranked among Florida's top holiday destinations! Stroll through a winter wonderland of over 1,000,000 sparkling lights, themed Christmas trees in every concourse, visits with Santa, live holiday musical entertainment, and waterfront shopping.
familyTip: Because it runs daily through New Year's Eve, weekday evenings (Monday–Wednesday) offer the same magical lights with much lighter crowds and easiest stroller navigation.
mapsQuery: Fishermen's Village, 1200 W Retta St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950

title: 50th Annual Venice Holiday Parade ("Golden Traditions")
address: West Venice Ave to Venice High School, Venice, FL 34285
description: A historic milestone! The 50th Golden Anniversary of the Venice Holiday Parade features over 100 lighted floats, marching bands, dancers, festive vehicles, and Santa Claus arriving to cap off Thanksgiving weekend.
familyTip: Spectators typically set out chairs along Venice Ave early in the afternoon. Make a day of it with family in Venice!
mapsQuery: West Venice Ave, Venice, FL 34285

title: King Fisher Christmas Light Canal Cruises
venue: King Fisher Fleet at Fishermen's Village
address: 1200 W Retta St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950
description: Board a comfortable sightseeing tour boat from Fishermen's Village to tour the protected residential canals of Punta Gorda Isles. View multi-million dollar homes and docks competing in neighborhood holiday light and music competitions.
familyTip: Must book several weeks ahead online at kingfisherfleet.com — tickets sell out quickly every single year! Bring a light jacket for the breeze on the water.
mapsQuery: King Fisher Fleet, 1200 W Retta St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950

title: Wellen Wonderland Tree Lighting Celebration
address: 19745 Wellen Pkwy, Venice, FL 34293
description: Kick off December with the lighting of Wellen Park's 32-foot lakeside holiday tree! Enjoy holiday carolers, free photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus, the 'Cottages for Kids' gingerbread trail, and seasonal drinks and treats.
familyTip: Great open grassy areas for kids to run around while waiting for the tree lighting. Bring picnic blankets.
mapsQuery: Downtown Wellen, 19745 Wellen Pkwy, Venice, FL 34293

title: North Port Poinsettia Parade & Tree Lighting Festival
venue: North Port City Center Front Green
address: 4970 City Center Blvd, North Port, FL 34286
description: North Port's biggest holiday celebration of the year! The 'Sleigh the Night Away' parade rolls down Sumter Blvd featuring lighted floats and vehicles, followed by the ceremonial lighting of the City Hall holiday tree, Santa's workshop, and mobile food vendors.
familyTip: Sumter Blvd closes for the parade at 4:30 PM, so approach via Price Blvd or West Price to access City Center parking lots.
mapsQuery: North Port City Center, 4970 City Center Blvd, North Port, FL

title: Venice Christmas Boat Parade
address: Albee Rd Bridge to Circus Bridge, Venice, FL 34285
description: A dazzling aquatic parade of illuminated yachts, pontoon boats, and sailboats decorated with moving light sculptures, holiday scenes, and sounding boat horns cruising south down the Intracoastal Waterway.
familyTip: Top public viewing spots with easy stroller access: Venetian Waterway Park trail, Venice Marina, or along the waterfront parks near the north jetty.
mapsQuery: Venetian Waterway Park, Venice, FL 34285

title: Wellen Park Holiday Glow Bike Ride & Dueling Pianos
address: 19745 Wellen Pkwy, Venice, FL 34293
description: Wrap your bicycles and strollers in glow sticks and string lights for a scenic, family-friendly slow roll around the 80-acre Grand Lake, followed by lively holiday dueling pianos under the stars at Solis Hall.
familyTip: Bring battery-powered fairy lights to clip onto kids' scooters, trikes, or strollers so they can participate in the glow!
mapsQuery: Solis Hall, Downtown Wellen, Venice, FL 34293

title: The Mayor's Hometown Christmas & Christmas Walk
address: 200 W Venice Ave, Venice, FL 34285
description: Step into a Hallmark-movie-style evening in historic Venice! Children can sit on Santa's lap in the park gazebo, listen to school and church youth choirs singing carols, and sip free hot cider while strolling decorated shop fronts.
familyTip: Centennial Park has a wonderful interactive children's splash pad and playground right next to the gazebo if the little ones need playtime.
mapsQuery: Centennial Park, 200 W Venice Ave, Venice, FL 34285

title: Peace River Gardens Aglow
address: 5827 Riverside Dr, Punta Gorda, FL 33982
description: Punta Gorda's enchanting nature-immersed light experience. Thousands of glowing fairy lights and botanical light sculptures illuminate the walking paths along the Peace River, accompanied by live acoustic holiday musicians, s'mores roasting pits, and hot chocolate stations.
familyTip: Pre-purchase timed tickets online at peacerivergardens.org. Boardwalks and trails are smooth and easy for strollers.
mapsQuery: Peace River Botanical & Sculpture Gardens, 5827 Riverside Dr, Punta Gorda, FL 33982

title: Annual Punta Gorda Christmas Boat Parade

description: Known as 'The Saturday Night Before Christmas Eve Boat Parade,' this cherished Punta Gorda Isles tradition features dozens of extravagantly illuminated motor yachts, sailboats, and catamarans navigating 4 miles of residential canals.
familyTip: Great public viewing spots with easy parking: along the rim canal bridges, Ponce de Leon Park, or join neighbors who host shoreline lawn watch parties.
mapsQuery: Ponce de Leon Park, Punta Gorda, FL 33950

description: Sing your favorite holiday carols with local choral groups as the sun sets over the Gulf of Mexico. Song sheets are handed out to everyone, with festive cookies and cider available.
familyTip: Bring lawn chairs, cozy sweaters, and battery candles for the kids when dusk falls.
mapsQuery: Maxine Barritt Park, 1800 Harbor Dr S, Venice, FL 34285

title: Fishermen's Village New Year's Eve & Fireworks
address: 1200 W Retta St, Punta Gorda, FL 33950
description: Southwest Florida's biggest family-friendly New Year's Eve blowout! Features multiple stages of live music, magicians, face painters, balloon artists, glow souvenirs, dancing, and a midnight fireworks display launched over Charlotte Harbor.
familyTip: If celebrating with younger toddlers who can't stay up until midnight, the 6:00 PM – 8:30 PM window is packed with fun kids entertainment, glowing lights, and treats without the late night squeeze!
